meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:
Finding a reliable pair of running shoes under ₹3,000 in India requires balancing durability, cushioning, and brand trust. While entry-level shoes from global brands often go on sale in this range, Indian-rooted brands also offer exceptional value.

The top running shoes available under ₹3,000 are categorized below by what they do best:

---

### 1. Best for Durability & Daily Training: Adidas Duramo Series (e.g., Duramo SL / Duramo Speed variants)

* **Approximate Price:** ₹2,200 – ₹2,999 (frequently discounted on the official Adidas India site and Myntra).
* **Why buy it:** Adidas Duramo shoes are staple entry-level running shoes. They feature lightweight mesh uppers for breathability and stable midsole cushioning that holds up well against regular road wear.
* **Best for:** Daily jogging, gym workouts, and short-to-mid distance road running (3K to 5K).

### 2. Best for Budget-Conscious Beginners: Campus Running Shoes (e.g., Campus Oxygen / Active variants)

* **Approximate Price:** ₹1,400 – ₹2,200
* **Why buy it:** Campus has become a massive favorite in India for offering high style and decent comfort at aggressive price points. They feature flexible soles and surprisingly plush step-in comfort for the price.
* **Best for:** Casual walkers, gym-goers, and absolute beginners on a strict budget who want maximum value for money.

### 3. Best for Fashion-Forward Sportswear: Puma (Entry-Level Performance lines like Fusion Pro or Galaxis Pro)

* **Approximate Price:** ₹2,000 – ₹2,999 (during seasonal sales on Puma India / Flipkart / Myntra).
* **Why buy it:** Puma frequently runs heavy discounts that bring their entry-level running and training shoes under ₹3,000. They offer great aesthetics, decent grip, and comfortable padding.[in.puma.com](https://in.puma.com/in/en/shop/shoes-under-3000#:~:text=Designed%20with%20lightweight%2C%20ultra-breathable%20materials%2C%20our%20shoes,your%20ensemble%20with%20our%20shoes%20under%203000.)
* **Best for:** All-day wear, light running, and gym sessions where looks and versatility matter as much as performance.

### 4. Best for Orthopedic Support & Walking: ASICS (Entry variants like Jolt or discounted Gel Contend/Excite sales)

* **Approximate Price:** Often drops close to ₹2,500–₹3,000 during major e-commerce festival sales (Flipkart/Amazon).
* **Why buy it:** If you can catch them on sale, entry-level ASICS shoes provide unmatched heel support, arch stability, and shock absorption.
* **Best for:** Pronation support, long walks, and injury-free jogging.

---

### Quick Buying Tips for India:

* **Check Official Outlets & Sales:** Brands like Adidas and Puma frequently list performance running shoes under ₹3,000 on their official Indian web stores during clearance sales.[in.puma.com](https://in.puma.com/in/en/shop/shoes-under-3000#:~:text=Buy%20Shoes%20Under%203000%20%26%20Get%20Upto,*%20IND%20categories.%20*%20Shop.%20*%20shoes-under-3000.)
* **Sizing:** If you have wider feet (common in India), look for brands like Campus or go a half-size up for Adidas/Puma performance fits to avoid toe cramping during runs.
